subject.title: Write tool lacks append mode — isolated cron sessions destroy shared files

question: Should OpenClaw accept `append?: boolean` on the existing `write` tool as the permanent model-facing append contract, or require a different append API before closing this issue?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the fix becomes a public tool contract observable by agents, extensions, and tests, so automation should not choose the API shape alone.

options.title: Accept append on write
options.body: Land the open implementation after rebase and review, keeping overwrite as the default and using `append: true` for safe accumulation.

options.title: Choose another append contract
options.body: Request a replacement shape such as `mode: "append"` or a dedicated append tool before merging any public API.

options.title: Defer code and document workarounds
options.body: Keep the issue open and rely on backup or `exec >>` workarounds, accepting that ordinary write calls still carry data-loss risk.

recommendation.title: Accept append on write
recommendation.body: Land the open implementation after rebase and review, keeping overwrite as the default and using `append: true` for safe accumulation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about the shared model-facing agent runtime API, and current history points to Peter as the strongest owner for that write-tool contract.
